notes.title: Steam keys from previously purchased bundles...
notes.content:
Hello all. A big thanks to all of you that previously purchasing the game before it's Steam release. 

Due to this being our first Steam release that was available elsewhere before it was on Steam, we're still learning the process of how key distribution for previous owner's works. So here are the immediate changes to the system of getting your Steam keys for a previous purchase:

 - Desura : Indie Royale bundle or other Desura bundle owners will now receive their keys from Desura directly.

 - Amazon and others: You will still need to contact us at support@onthelevelgames.com with proof of purchase attached to the request.
